reproduce.title: Verify FancyZones report
setup: Windows 11 25H2, ultrawide monitor, File Explorer and Opera; save current layout.
steps: 1. With Windows Snap enabled, place a window at the top edge in a 1 px-spaced zone and single-click its lower resize border.
2. Repeat with 5 px spacing in Opera.
3. Exit PowerToys and manually reproduce the same window bounds, then repeat the same click.
4. Repeat the control with Windows Snap disabled and record which cases maximize.
reproduce.expected_result: A single click does not vertically maximize; any failure with PowerToys exited establishes that a FancyZones-only fix is insufficient.

judgment.rationale: First reproduce the same lower-edge click at matched bounds with PowerToys exited and Windows Snap on; the ZIP request is conditional on a PowerToys-only difference.
evidence: The original report distinguishes 1 px padding across apps from 5 px padding in Opera and says disabling Windows Snap stops the symptom.
A second reporter sees the same problem with FancyZones disabled. That is not equivalent to fully exiting PowerToys or matching window bounds.
judgment.recommended_action: First reproduce the same lower-edge click at matched bounds with PowerToys exited and Windows Snap on; the ZIP request is conditional on a PowerToys-only difference.

fix_assessment.rationale: A FancyZones change is not justified until the native Snap control rules out the same behavior outside PowerToys.
